answer: Jetty exits: each identity's earnings sit behind a stake anchor and can only leave through a slow exit jetty, a 20-epoch unbonding queue. While coins wait on the jetty, anyone can file a linkage proof (shared keys, funding trail, copied answers) and the queued funds of every linked key are slashed. Proofs are written to the ledger like basalt, so old evidence never washes out. A sybil farm must lock capital for 100 keys at once and risk losing it all; an honest agent just waits.
